full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic oil painting looks down a damp woodland path where a lone figure and a small dog walk away into pale mist. The path begins broadly at the lower edge, its uneven light surface marked by wet patches and short soft shadows, then narrows and bends gently into the middle distance. Near the center, the dark-clad walker is seen from behind in a brimmed hat, with one arm hanging beside the body. The dog keeps close to the person's right, its small silhouette separated by a strip of bright ground. A tall tree anchors the left foreground, with a dark rough trunk, dense brown-green undergrowth at its base, and a spread of yellow-ochre autumn leaves filling much of the upper left. More slender trunks recede behind it in cool shade. On the right, lower shrubs and a delicate dark tree frame the view, their foliage softer and more scattered. The path opens toward a hazy valley of muted blue-gray and pale green, with the distant hillside nearly disappearing into an overcast sky. Thick, varied brushstrokes describe the grass and leaves near the viewer, while the background is smoothed by atmospheric haze. The subdued daylight comes from the bright open distance, catching the damp path and leaf edges while leaving the foreground trunks dark. There is no readable text. The overall composition uses the curving path and two small silhouettes to lead the eye into a cool, spacious distance, balancing warm autumn foliage with quiet gray-green mist.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实油画沿潮湿的林间小径望去，一名独行者与一只小狗背对观者，走入浅色薄雾。小径从下缘宽阔地开始，不平整的浅亮表面有湿斑和短而柔的影子，随后收窄并轻轻弯进中景。画面中央附近，深衣行者戴宽檐帽，从背后可见，一只手臂垂在身侧。小狗紧挨人的右边，一条亮色地面将它的小剪影与人分开。高大的树木稳住左侧前景，粗糙深色树干基部有密集棕绿灌丛，金赭色秋叶铺满左上大部分空间。更细的树干在背后退入冷调阴影。右侧，低矮灌丛和一棵纤细的深色树框住视线，枝叶更柔和、也更稀散。小径通向雾蒙蒙的低谷，那里是低饱和蓝灰和淡绿，远方山坡几乎消失于阴天之中。厚薄不一的笔触描绘近处的草与叶，背景则被大气薄霾抹柔。低调的日光来自明亮的远方开口，照亮潮湿小径与叶片边缘，让前景树干保持深暗。画中没有可读文字。整体构图用弯曲小径和两个小剪影引导视线进入清凉而开阔的远景，使暖色秋叶与安静的灰绿薄雾取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting combines tactile, varied foreground brushwork with soft atmospheric recession. Warm ocher, brown, and olive notes cluster in closer textured masses, while distant layers cool toward blue-gray and pale green. Dark vertical accents frame a lighter central passage, creating an easy path for the eye without rigid symmetry. Individual marks remain visible near the lower and side edges, then merge gradually into soft, low-contrast shapes farther back. Diffuse overcast illumination makes light surfaces gently luminous and damp-looking, while deep shadows remain concentrated around the nearest masses. The palette is earthy and restrained, with warmth and coolness separating depth more than strong linework does. The overall effect is contemplative and spacious, using gradual loss of detail and a quiet bright opening to suggest distance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画结合可触、富于变化的前景笔触与柔和的大气退远。暖赭、棕色和橄榄绿色聚在较近的纹理色块中，远处层次则逐渐冷却成蓝灰和淡绿。深色纵向重音框住中央较亮的通道，不靠僵硬对称也给视线一条自然路径。近处的下缘和两侧保留独立笔痕，向远处逐渐汇成柔和、低对比形状。阴天的弥散照明使浅色表面温和发亮，带有潮湿感，深影则集中在最近的色块周围。配色朴实而克制，深度主要由冷暖分离，而非粗重线条建立。整体效果沉思而开阔，以细节逐渐消失和安静的明亮开口提示距离。
theme_en: A lone walker and dog on a misty autumn path
theme_zh: 一人一犬行走在薄雾弥漫的秋日小径上
name: David Shepherd
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
